dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Hi. Is there something *coughs* I can do for you? *coughs*

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I am... *coughs* making a wish.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I just toss the coin *coughs* into the pool just like this, and *coughs* make a wish...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: You must be *coughs* sincere and do it every day for the fountain fairy to hear you... *coughs*

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... I can't stop coughing...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: What do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Oh... I've been *coughs* unwell for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I wish that *coughs* the fountain fairy could help me *coughs* get better.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: So I can stop *coughs* being a burden to my parents and my *coughs* brother Anthony.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Be well.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I hope *coughs* all your wishes will be granted soon... *coughs*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: *cough* To tell the truth, I made a wish to the fountain fairy when the dragon attacked, wishing that it would keep Mondstadt safe.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Now, both the storm and the danger has passed. Does that mean that the fountain fairy truly exists?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I wish that the fairy can make me well soon — that would lessen my family's burden a little... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Thanks to Anthony and the blessings of the fountain fairy, I've been getting better...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You haven't made a full recovery yet?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Not yet. I still cough at times, but I'm much better than before.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I want to get well soon... That way, I won't burden Anthony and the others any further.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I'd also be able to do some things that I want to do as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The fountain fairy?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Yes. I heard from Anthony that he was able to get a prescription from Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: To think that he was able to get a prescription from such a distant place so smoothly... the fountain fairy might have heard my wishes after all.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: She must have protected Anthony and helped him to obtain that prescription.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Once I've made a fully recovery, I must make a trip to Springvale...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you, and get well soon.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Goodbye. My wishes have been granted, and I hope that yours will soon come true as well.
